mapper.select: -- 현재 ACTIVE 규칙에 OFF 제어가 있으면 새 네트워크 재시도를 예약하지 않는다. SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_policies p JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases r ON r.id=p.rule_release_id WHERE p.policy_status_code='ACTIVE' AND p.mode_code='OFF' AND r.release_status_code='ACTIVE')
mapper.sql: FROM announcement_attachment_jobs WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND requested_by IS NOT NULL AND operation_code IN ('COLLECT','RETRY_FILES') AND created_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '24 hours'
mapper.select: -- source 잠금 아래 60초 간격/최근 24시간 최대 3회 수동 재시도를 확인한다. 같은 멱등 요청은 이 검사를 반복하지 않는다. SELECT count(1)<3 AND count(1) FILTER (WHERE created_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '60 seconds')=0
mapper.insert: -- 사용자가 선택한 source/set의 실제 파일 ID만 고정한다. URL/profile을 요청으로 받지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_retry_files(job_id,source_id,reference_set_id,file_id) VALUES (#{jobId},#{sourceId},#{setId},#{fileId})
mapper.select: -- 유효 lease의 고정 원래 목록만 반환한다. 원본 extraction 텍스트는 DB 복제 경로에 남긴다. SELECT f.id,f.safe_locator_json::text,f.stable_locator_hash,f.display_name,f.document_role_code,f.role_origin_code, f.detected_type_code,(scope.file_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_selected FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j JOIN announcement_source_attachment_files f ON f.source_id=j.source_id AND f.set_id=j.reference_set_id LEFT JOIN announcement_attachment_retry_files scope ON scope.job_id=j.id AND scope.file_id=f.id WHERE j.id=#{jobId} AND j.lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND j.job_status_code='RUNNING' AND j.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND j.operation_code='RETRY_FILES' AND j.set_id IS NULL ORDER BY f.sort_order,f.id LIMIT 11
